reason: Equivalent. This normalises the options bag in unsubscribe(). The two versions differ only for a value that is truthy but not an object — a string, a number, true, a function. In the original those become {}; in the mutant they are kept as-is. Either way the next two lines read o.as and o.reason off the value, and none of those types carries either property, so both yield undefined: the status falls back to UNSUBSCRIBED and the reason to ''. There is no input that produces a different subscriber list. The behaviour that matters — that an absent options bag still records a plain unsubscribe, and that an explicit as/reason is honoured — is asserted in sections 1 and 9.
